title: Error Codes Extension Schema (v1)
description:
错误码扩展契约（v1 实施）。新增 wallet / recharge / refund / coupon / expiry / quota / points 七类错误码，追加到 error-codes-schema.json 的 error_codes 数组。

本契约不修改既有 error-codes-schema.json，仅声明新增错误码清单。category 枚举需同步扩展（新增 'wallet' / 'recharge' / 'refund' / 'coupon' / 'expiry' / 'quota' / 'points'）。

error_codes.description: 新增错误码列表（追加到 error-codes-schema.json）

predefined_codes.description: v1 预定义新增错误码清单（文档参考用）

INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.message_template: Insufficient wallet balance: required={required}, actual={actual}, user={user_id}, server={server_id}
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: 钱包余额不足。触发场景：下单/续费/付费 CDK 兑换时 balance < amount。注：既有 impl errors.ts:498 已用此 code，本次首次纳入 public 契约（B-NEW-2 修复：保留既有命名，http_status 对齐既有 shop.ts:409 的 400）

DAILY_REWARD_ALREADY_CLAIMED.message_template: Daily reward already claimed today: user={user_id}, server={server_id}, date={date}
DAILY_REWARD_ALREADY_CLAIMED.description: 今日已领取每日点券奖励。触发场景：walletService.claimDailyReward 按 last_daily_claim_date 判断今日已领。注：既有 impl errors.ts:507 已用此 code，本次首次纳入 public 契约（S-NEW-2 修复）

WALLET_NOT_FOUND.description: 钱包不存在。触发场景：用户在某实例未创建钱包（未绑定）

RECHARGE_CDK_INVALID.description: 充值 CDK 不存在。触发场景：recharge_cdks 查询未命中

RECHARGE_CDK_ALREADY_REDEEMED.message_template: Recharge CDK already redeemed or in progress: code={code}
RECHARGE_CDK_ALREADY_REDEEMED.description: 充值 CDK 已兑换或正在兑换中。触发场景：乐观锁 UPDATE 影响行数=0（status 非 unused）

RECHARGE_CDK_EXPIRED.description: 充值 CDK 已过期。触发场景：expires_at < now

RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Recharge CDK batch not found: batch_id={batch_id}
RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_NOT_FOUND.description: 充值 CDK 批次不存在。触发场景：recharge_cdk_batches 查询未命中

RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_CREATE_FAILED.message_template: Recharge CDK batch create failed: reason={reason}
RECHARGE_CDK_BATCH_CREATE_FAILED.description: 充值 CDK 批次创建失败。触发场景：total_count 超限 / face_value 非法 / 批量插入失败

REFUND_ORDER_NOT_FOUND.description: 退款申请不存在。触发场景：wallet_refund_orders 查询未命中

REFUND_ORDER_NOT_PENDING.message_template: Refund order not pending: refund_id={refund_id}, current_status={status}
REFUND_ORDER_NOT_PENDING.description: 退款申请非 pending 状态。触发场景：approve/reject 时 status 非 pending

REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_LIMIT.message_template: Refund amount exceeds limit: requested={requested}, max={max}
REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_LIMIT.description: 退款金额超限。触发场景：amount > system_config.wallet.refund_max_amount

ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE.description: 订单不可退款。触发场景：shop_orders.status != 'pending'（已领取订单需走补偿发放）

COUPON_INVALID.description: 优惠券无效或已过期。触发场景：coupons 查询未命中或 valid_until < now

COUPON_ALREADY_CLAIMED.message_template: Coupon already claimed by user: code={code}, user={user_id}
COUPON_ALREADY_CLAIMED.description: 用户已领取过该优惠券。触发场景：user_coupons 已有 active 记录

COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.message_template: Coupon usage limit exceeded: code={code}, used={used}, limit={limit}
COUPON_USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.description: 优惠券已达使用上限。触发场景：coupons.used_count >= coupons.usage_limit

COUPON_NOT_APPLICABLE.description: 优惠券不适用于当前订单。触发场景：min_order_amount 不满足 / scope 不匹配 / 已过期

INSTANCE_NOT_RENEWABLE.description: 实例不可续费。触发场景：expiry_status='cleaned'（已清理磁盘的实例不可恢复）

INSTANCE_EXPIRY_CONFIG_ERROR.message_template: Instance expiry config error: key={key}, value={value}, reason={reason}
INSTANCE_EXPIRY_CONFIG_ERROR.description: 实例到期配置错误。触发场景：system_config.instance.expiry.* 配置项缺失或非法

QUOTA_LIMIT_REACHED.message_template: Quota limit reached: user={user_id}, resource={resource_type}, used={used}, limit={limit}
QUOTA_LIMIT_REACHED.description: 配额已达上限。触发场景：创建实例/上传文件时超 max_instances / max_disk_mb / max_players_total

QUOTA_CONFIG_ERROR.description: 配额配置错误。触发场景：vip.quota_overrides JSON 解析失败

VIP_POINTS_CONFIG_ERROR.message_template: VIP points config error: key={key}, reason={reason}
VIP_POINTS_CONFIG_ERROR.description: VIP 积分配置错误。触发场景：vip.points_thresholds JSON 解析失败或等级缺失

VIP_LEVEL_UPGRADE_FAILED.message_template: VIP level upgrade failed: user={user_id}, server={server_id}, target_level={target_level}, reason={reason}
VIP_LEVEL_UPGRADE_FAILED.description: VIP 等级升级失败。触发场景：vipService.setVipLevel 抛错（无 active 绑定记录等）

VIP_CHECKIN_ALREADY_TODAY.message_template: VIP checkin already done today: user={user_id}, server={server_id}, date={date}
VIP_CHECKIN_ALREADY_TODAY.description: 今日已签到。触发场景：last_checkin_date == today

BINDING_NOT_FOUND.message_template: Active binding not found: user={user_id}, server={server_id}
BINDING_NOT_FOUND.description: 无 active 绑定记录。触发场景：vipPointService.addPoints / checkin 时用户未绑定实例（需先 bindInstance）。注：既有 vipService.updateBindingVip 也抛此错误，本错误码统一覆盖
